name: Popsicle
fix_description: In _updateFeesReward, the reward accounting does not properly reset when LP shares are transferred. New holders inherit unclaimed rewards from previous holders, allowing the same fees to be claimed multiple times. Fix: update perSharePaid for both sender and recipient in the transfer function, or track rewards per-token-id rather than per-address.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a repeated multi-step fee-accounting abuse across several Popsicle vaults using a large multi-asset flash loan, token-share transfers between helper contracts, and carefully ordered collect/withdraw calls. While the underlying bug is not extremely obscure, reproducing it requires understanding protocol-specific reward/share logic and orchestrating multiple contract interactions rather than a simple one-call exploit.
